participation.context: Not spoken to. He thinks she heard the latch. She does not come up.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.quote: I am not going down to be told so.

story.body: You lifted the latch softly and it sprang. You had sneezed twice on the walk. You stayed up, and you did not ask to be told you were ill.

relations.note: a latch she can hear, and no conversation tonight

title: Came in softly and stayed up
